  • step_cloud_schemas.classes.sub_cause_code

Source code for step_cloud_schemas.classes.sub_cause_code

   1"""Module containing the ETSI ITS sub cause code enumerations of DENM events.
   2
   3Every cause code of the ETSI ITS Common Data Dictionary (ETSI TS 102 894-2,
   4``CauseCodeChoice``) carries a sub cause code whose meaning depends on the cause code.
   5This module defines one string enumeration per sub cause code type. Each member value is
   6the ASN.1 identifier followed by its ASN.1 integer value (e.g.
   7``trafficJamIncreasing3``), consistently with CauseCode. The cause codes that use the
   8generic ``SubCauseCodeType`` share GenericSubCauseCode, which only defines the
   9``unavailable`` value.
  10
  11Complexity:
  12    - Time: O(1) for every operation in this module (enumeration lookup and
  13      JSON schema generation).
  14    - Space: O(1) for every operation; the enumerations have a fixed size.
  15
  16Classes:
  17    - TrafficConditionSubCauseCode: Sub cause codes of the trafficCondition cause code.
  18      Complexity: time O(1), space O(1).
  19    - AccidentSubCauseCode: Sub cause codes of the accident cause code. Complexity: time
  20      O(1), space O(1).
  21    - RoadworksSubCauseCode: Sub cause codes of the roadworks cause code. Complexity:
  22      time O(1), space O(1).
  23    - ImpassabilitySubCauseCode: Sub cause codes of the impassability cause code.
  24      Complexity: time O(1), space O(1).
  25    - AdhesionSubCauseCode: Sub cause codes of the adhesion cause code. Complexity: time
  26      O(1), space O(1).
  27    - HazardousLocationSurfaceConditionSubCauseCode: Sub cause codes of the
  28      hazardousLocation-SurfaceCondition cause code. Complexity: time O(1), space O(1).
  29    - HazardousLocationObstacleOnTheRoadSubCauseCode: Sub cause codes of the
  30      hazardousLocation-ObstacleOnTheRoad cause code. Complexity: time O(1), space O(1).
  31    - HazardousLocationAnimalOnTheRoadSubCauseCode: Sub cause codes of the
  32      hazardousLocation-AnimalOnTheRoad cause code. Complexity: time O(1), space O(1).
  33    - HumanPresenceOnTheRoadSubCauseCode: Sub cause codes of the humanPresenceOnTheRoad
  34      cause code. Complexity: time O(1), space O(1).
  35    - WrongWayDrivingSubCauseCode: Sub cause codes of the wrongWayDriving cause code.
  36      Complexity: time O(1), space O(1).
  37    - RescueRecoveryAndMaintenanceWorkInProgressSubCauseCode: Sub cause codes of the
  38      rescueRecoveryAndMaintenanceWorkInProgress cause code. Complexity: time O(1),
  39      space O(1).
  40    - AdverseWeatherConditionWindSubCauseCode: Sub cause codes of the
  41      adverseWeatherCondition-Wind cause code. Complexity: time O(1), space O(1).
  42    - AdverseWeatherConditionVisibilitySubCauseCode: Sub cause codes of the
  43      adverseWeatherCondition-Visibility cause code. Complexity: time O(1), space O(1).
  44    - AdverseWeatherConditionPrecipitationSubCauseCode: Sub cause codes of the
  45      adverseWeatherCondition-Precipitation cause code. Complexity: time O(1), space
  46      O(1).
  47    - SlowVehicleSubCauseCode: Sub cause codes of the slowVehicle cause code.
  48      Complexity: time O(1), space O(1).
  49    - DangerousEndOfQueueSubCauseCode: Sub cause codes of the dangerousEndOfQueue cause
  50      code. Complexity: time O(1), space O(1).
  51    - VehicleBreakdownSubCauseCode: Sub cause codes of the vehicleBreakdown cause code.
  52      Complexity: time O(1), space O(1).
  53    - PostCrashSubCauseCode: Sub cause codes of the postCrash cause code. Complexity:
  54      time O(1), space O(1).
  55    - HumanProblemSubCauseCode: Sub cause codes of the humanProblem cause code.
  56      Complexity: time O(1), space O(1).
  57    - StationaryVehicleSubCauseCode: Sub cause codes of the stationaryVehicle cause
  58      code. Complexity: time O(1), space O(1).
  59    - EmergencyVehicleApproachingSubCauseCode: Sub cause codes of the
  60      emergencyVehicleApproaching cause code. Complexity: time O(1), space O(1).
  61    - HazardousLocationDangerousCurveSubCauseCode: Sub cause codes of the
  62      hazardousLocation-DangerousCurve cause code. Complexity: time O(1), space O(1).
  63    - CollisionRiskSubCauseCode: Sub cause codes of the collisionRisk cause code.
  64      Complexity: time O(1), space O(1).
  65    - SignalViolationSubCauseCode: Sub cause codes of the signalViolation cause code.
  66      Complexity: time O(1), space O(1).
  67    - DangerousSituationSubCauseCode: Sub cause codes of the dangerousSituation cause
  68      code. Complexity: time O(1), space O(1).
  69    - RailwayLevelCrossingSubCauseCode: Sub cause codes of the railwayLevelCrossing
  70      cause code. Complexity: time O(1), space O(1).
  71    - GenericSubCauseCode: Generic sub cause codes of the cause codes without a
  72      dedicated enumeration. Complexity: time O(1), space O(1).
  73"""
  74
  75# Standard Library Imports
  76from enum import StrEnum
  77
  78# step_cloud_schemas Package Imports

  86class TrafficConditionSubCauseCode(StrEnum):
  87    """Sub cause codes of the trafficCondition cause code (ETSI TS 102 894-2
  88    ``TrafficConditionSubCauseCode``).
  89
  90    Attributes:
  91        UNAVAILABLE (str): In case further detailed information on the traffic condition
  92            is unavailable.
  93        INCREASED_VOLUME_OF_TRAFFIC (str): In case the type of traffic condition is
  94            increased traffic volume.
  95        TRAFFIC_JAM_SLOWLY_INCREASING (str): In case the type of traffic condition is a
  96            traffic jam which volume is increasing slowly.
  97        TRAFFIC_JAM_INCREASING (str): In case the type of traffic condition is a traffic
  98            jam which volume is increasing.
  99        TRAFFIC_JAM_STRONGLY_INCREASING (str): In case the type of traffic condition is a
 100            traffic jam which volume is strongly increasing.
 101        TRAFFIC_JAM (str): In case the type of traffic condition is a traffic jam and no
 102            further detailed information about its volume is available.
 103        TRAFFIC_JAM_SLIGHTLY_DECREASING (str): In case the type of traffic condition is a
 104            traffic jam which volume is decreasing slowly.
 105        TRAFFIC_JAM_DECREASING (str): In case the type of traffic condition is a traffic
 106            jam which volume is decreasing.
 107        TRAFFIC_JAM_STRONGLY_DECREASING (str): In case the type of traffic condition is a
 108            traffic jam which volume is decreasing rapidly.
 109        TRAFFIC_JAM_STABLE (str): In case the traffic condition is a traffic jam with
 110            stable volume.
 111
 112    Complexity:
 113        - Time: O(1), dominated by ``__get_pydantic_json_schema__``'s single
 114          schema update with fixed-size dictionary keys.
 115        - Space: O(1), no additional data structures are allocated.
 116    """
 117
 118    __slots__ = ()
 119
 120    UNAVAILABLE = "unavailable0"
 121    INCREASED_VOLUME_OF_TRAFFIC = "increasedVolumeOfTraffic1"
 122    TRAFFIC_JAM_SLOWLY_INCREASING = "trafficJamSlowlyIncreasing2"
 123    TRAFFIC_JAM_INCREASING = "trafficJamIncreasing3"
 124    TRAFFIC_JAM_STRONGLY_INCREASING = "trafficJamStronglyIncreasing4"
 125    TRAFFIC_JAM = "trafficJam5"
 126    TRAFFIC_JAM_SLIGHTLY_DECREASING = "trafficJamSlightlyDecreasing6"
 127    TRAFFIC_JAM_DECREASING = "trafficJamDecreasing7"
 128    TRAFFIC_JAM_STRONGLY_DECREASING = "trafficJamStronglyDecreasing8"
 129    TRAFFIC_JAM_STABLE = "trafficJamStable9"

 179    """Sub cause codes of the roadworks cause code (ETSI TS 102 894-2

 181
 182    Attributes:
 183        UNAVAILABLE (str): In case further detailed information on roadworks is
 184            unavailable.
 185        ROAD_OR_CARRIAGEWAY_CLOSURE (str): In case roadworks are ongoing which comprise
 186            the closure of the entire road or of one entire carriageway.
 187        ROAD_MARKING_WORK_DEPRECATED (str): Deprecated since covered by 3 or 4.
 188        MOVING_LANE_CLOSURE (str): In case moving roadworks are ongoing, which comprise
 189            the closure of a lane.
 190        STATIONARY_LANE_CLOSURE (str): In case stationary roadworks are ongoing, which
 191            comprise the closure of one or multiple lanes but not of the
 192            carriageway/road.
 193        STREET_CLEANING_DEPRECATED (str): Deprecated since not pertinent to roadworks and
 194            already covered by SlowVehicleSubCauseCode.
 195        WINTER_SERVICE_DEPRECATED (str): Deprecated since not pertinent to roadworks and
 196            already covered by SlowVehicleSubCauseCode.
 197        SETUP_PHASE (str): In case the work zone is being setup which, may comprise the
 198            closure of one or multiple lanes but the carriageway/road is not closed.
 199        REMODELLING_PHASE (str): In case the work zone is being changed, which may
 200            comprise the closure of one or multiple lanes but the carriageway/road is
 201            not closed.
 202        DISMANTLING_PHASE (str): In case the work zone is being dismantled after finished
 203            works, which comprised the closure of one or multiple lanes but the
 204            carriageway/road was not closed.
 205        CARRIAGEWAY_CROSSOVER (str): In case the work zone includes lanes that are
 206            re-directed to another carriageway.
 207
 208    Complexity:
 209        - Time: O(1), dominated by ``__get_pydantic_json_schema__``'s single
 210          schema update with fixed-size dictionary keys.
 211        - Space: O(1), no additional data structures are allocated.
 212    """
 213

 215
 216    UNAVAILABLE = "unavailable0"
 217    ROAD_OR_CARRIAGEWAY_CLOSURE = "roadOrCarriagewayClosure1"
 218    ROAD_MARKING_WORK_DEPRECATED = "roadMarkingWork-deprecated2"
 219    MOVING_LANE_CLOSURE = "movingLaneClosure3"
 220    STATIONARY_LANE_CLOSURE = "stationaryLaneClosure4"
